scanNote:
Culture Clips bo'limining 4-mavzusi: 'East Meets West' (Sharq G'arb bilan uchrashadi). Bosilgan bet raqami: 160.

Betda:
• Sarlavha: '4 East Meets West'
• 'Pre-reading Activity' — 1a va 1b mashqlari
• 'Reading' — 2a (NY/L belgilash, 5 ta gap), 2b, 2c, 2d
• BIRINChI MATN — Nyu-Yorkdagi Chinatown haqida
• 'Speaking' — uchta muhokama savoli
• Ikkita surat: A — o'yilgan ajdaho boshi (ko'k-qizil bo'yalgan, og'zida qizil shar); B — qizil likobchada qovurilgan xamir bo'laklari (chuchvara/vontonlar) va qora tayoqchalar

⚠ C, D, E, F suratlari va IKKINChI MATN (London) 161-betda.

⚠⚠ 2a mashqidagi 5 ta gapga javob berish uchun IKKALA matnni ham o'qish kerak: 1, 2, 5 → Nyu-York matnidan; 3, 4 → London matnidan.

⚠ Sariq bilan ta'kidlangan so'zlar (2d mashqi uchun): 160-betda — largest, huge, delicious, amazing; 161-betda — cheap, feature.

⚠ HALOL IZOH: matnda 'oriental' so'zi ishlatilgan ('oriental dishes', 'oriental carvings'). Bu — ESKI atama. Hozirgi ingliz tilida odamlar va madaniyat haqida 'Asian' yoki 'East Asian' deyiladi. Buyumlar haqida ham 'oriental' kamayib bormoqda.

⚠ FAKT TEKShIRUVI: Nyu-York Chinatown'i Manxettenning sharqiy qismida — to'g'ri; London Chinatown'i Gerrard Street atrofida — to'g'ri; sherlar raqsi va qizil pakatlarda pul berish an'analari — to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: 1  a) Which places do you think these articles are about?   b) Look at the pictures (A-F). Which shows ... a dragon carving? a Chinese lion dance? firecrackers? a Chinese Gate? a Chinese dish? Chinese lanterns?
exercises.instructionUz: 1  a) Sizningcha bu maqolalar qaysi joylar haqida?   b) Rasmlarga qarang (A-F). Qaysi birida ... o'yilgan ajdaho? xitoy sherlar raqsi? petardalar? Xitoy darvozasi? xitoy taomi? xitoy fonuslari bor?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'PRE-READING ACTIVITY' —
matnni o'qishdan OLDINGI mashq.


1a) JAVOBI:

  Maqolalar IKKI ShAHAR haqida:
     NEW YORK va LONDON

  ⚠ Aniqrog'i — ularning ChINATOWN
  (Xitoy mahallasi) qismlari haqida.


⚠ 'CHINATOWN' NIMA:

  'Chinatown' = katta shahar ichidagi
  XITOY MAHALLASI.

  Xitoydan kelgan muhojirlar o'z
  do'konlari, restoranlari va
  an'analari bilan yashaydigan hudud.

  ⚠ 'China' + 'town' — qo'shma so'z,
  BOSh HARF bilan yoziladi (joy nomi).


1b) JAVOBLAR:

  A  — a dragon carving
         (o'yilgan ajdaho)      160-bet
  B  — a Chinese dish
         (xitoy taomi)          160-bet
  C  — Chinese lanterns
         (xitoy fonuslari)      161-bet
  D  — a Chinese Gate
         (Xitoy darvozasi)      161-bet
  E  — a Chinese lion dance
         (sherlar raqsi)        161-bet
  F  — firecrackers
         (petardalar)           161-bet


⚠ 'A CARVING' NIMA:

  'to carve' = o'ymoq, kesib naqsh solmoq
  'a carving' = o'yma naqsh, o'yilgan
     buyum

  ⚠ A suratda: yog'ochdan o'yilgan va
  bo'yalgan ajdaho boshi, og'zida qizil
  shar.

  ⚠ Matnda: 'shops decorated with oriental
  CARVINGS and images'.


⚠ 'FIRECRACKERS' — HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA:

  'a firecracker' = petarda

  ⚠ 'fire' (olov) + 'cracker' (taraqlovchi)

  ⚠ 145-betdagi 'FIREWORKS' (salyut) bilan
  ADAShTIRMANG:
     'fireworks' — osmonga otiladi,
        chiroyli
     'firecrackers' — yerda taraqlaydi,
        OVOZ uchun

  ⚠ Matnda: 'the sound of NOISY
  FIRECRACKERS fills the air'.


⚠ 'A LANTERN' va 'A LAMP':

     'a lantern' = fonus (ko'chirib
        yuriladigan, qog'oz yoki shishali)
     'a lamp' = chiroq (stol yoki poldagi)

  ⚠ 135-betda 'a lamp' bor edi.


⚠ 'A DISH' — IKKI MA'NO:

     'a dish' = TAOM
        'oriental dishes' = sharq taomlari
     'a dish' = LIKOBChA, idish
        'wash the dishes' = idish yuvmoq

  ⚠ B suratda ikkalasi ham bor: likobcha
  (dish) ustida taom (dish)!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Chinatown    = xitoy mahallasi
  a carving    = o'yma naqsh
  to carve     = o'ymoq
  a dragon     = ajdaho
  a lion dance = sherlar raqsi
  firecrackers = petardalar
  a gate       = darvoza
  a lantern    = fonus
  a dish       = taom; likobcha
  chopsticks   = xitoy tayoqchalari

pairs.leftUz: A — yog'ochdan o'yilgan va bo'yalgan ajdaho boshi: ko'k yol, qizil og'iz, oq tishlar, og'zida qizil shar
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'to carve' = o'ymoq;
'a carving' = o'yilgan buyum.

Nyu-York matnida: 'shops decorated with
oriental CARVINGS and images'.

⚠ Ajdaho — Xitoy madaniyatida OMAD va
KUCH ramzi (yovuz mavjudot emas!).
G'arb ertaklaridagi ajdahodan farq qiladi.

pairs.leftUz: B — qizil likobchada qovurilgan xamir bo'laklari va qora tayoqchalar
pairs.whyUz:
Nyu-York matnida: 'hundreds of Chinese
restaurants where you can try DELICIOUS
ORIENTAL DISHES'.

⚠⚠ 'a dish' IKKI MA'NODA: TAOM va LIKOBCHA.
Suratda ikkalasi ham bor!

⚠ Qora tayoqchalar — 'CHOPSTICKS'
(har doim ko'plikda).

pairs.leftUz: C — osilgan qog'oz fonuslar: pushti-oq va sariq, naqshlangan
pairs.whyUz:
London matnida: 'London's Chinatown is
DECORATED with LANTERNS and flags'.

⚠ 'a lantern' = fonus (ko'chirib yuriladigan);
'a lamp' = chiroq (stoldagi).

⚠ Qizil fonus — Xitoy Yangi yilining asosiy
bezagi, omad ramzi.

pairs.leftUz: D — cherepitsali tomli darvoza, xitoycha yozuvlar va 'Chinatown' yozuvi
pairs.whyUz:
London matnida: 'The CHINESE GATE, which is
a beautiful oriental entrance to Chinatown,
is GREEN AND RED and people see it as a
symbol of the success of the area.'

⚠ Matnda darvoza YAShIL va QIZIL deyilgan —
suratda ham shu ranglar ko'rinadi.

pairs.leftUz: E — olomon orasida katta rangli sher niqobi va libosi, ichida odamlar
pairs.whyUz:
Ikkala matnda ham bor!

Nyu-York: 'watching the amazing dragon and
LION DANCES'.
London: 'the LION DANCE is the main feature
of the celebration'.

⚠ Sher libosini ikki kishi kiyadi: biri bosh,
biri dum tomonda.

pairs.leftUz: F — qizil o'ramlar, ustida yorliqlar, yonida binafsha tayoqchalar
pairs.whyUz:
London matnida: 'the sound of NOISY
FIRECRACKERS fills the air'.

⚠⚠ 145-betdagi 'FIREWORKS' (salyut) bilan
ADASHTIRMANG:
  fireworks — osmonga otiladi, chiroyli
  firecrackers — yerda taraqlaydi, OVOZ uchun

⚠ Xitoy an'anasida shovqin YOMON RUHLARNI
quvadi.

exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT 1 - NEW YORK: Did you know that there are more Chinese people living in the United States than in any other country outside of Asia?
exercises.instructionUz: 1-MATN — NYU-YORK: Osiyodan tashqarida boshqa hech qaysi mamlakatda AQShdagichalik ko'p xitoylik yashamasligini bilarmidingiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
BIRINChI MATN — NYU-YORK ChINATOWN'i.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'Did you know that there are more
   Chinese people living in the United
   States than in any other country
   outside of Asia? Or that America's
   LARGEST Chinese community is BASED in
   New York City's very own Chinatown?
   Any visitor to Manhattan's east side
   will feel as if they are in another
   world. It's a HUGE area with hundreds
   of Chinese restaurants where you can
   try DELICIOUS ORIENTAL dishes. Visitors
   enjoy walking along the WINDING streets
   full of colourful shops decorated with
   oriental carvings and images. There are
   also fruit, vegetable, meat and fish
   markets, selling everything you need to
   make your own Chinese meal.

   New York City's Chinatown really COMES
   TO LIFE during the Chinese New Year
   celebrations. The streets are CROWDED
   with people of all nationalities
   watching the AMAZING dragon and lion
   dances and admiring the INCREDIBLE
   costumes. Traditionally, Chinese
   shopkeepers must pay the lion dancers
   so that their shop has a good year. The
   more money they pay, the more luck they
   will have.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Osiyodan tashqarida boshqa hech qaysi
   mamlakatda AQShdagichalik ko'p xitoylik
   yashamasligini bilarmidingiz? Yoki
   Amerikaning eng katta xitoy jamoasi
   aynan Nyu-Yorkning o'z Chinatown'ida
   joylashganini? Manxettenning sharqiy
   qismiga kelgan har qanday mehmon o'zini
   boshqa dunyoda his qiladi. Bu — yuzlab
   xitoy restoranlari bo'lgan ulkan hudud;
   u yerda mazali sharq taomlarini tatib
   ko'rish mumkin. Mehmonlar sharq o'ymalari
   va tasvirlari bilan bezatilgan rang-barang
   do'konlarga to'la egri-bugri ko'chalarda
   sayr qilishni yoqtiradi. Bundan tashqari
   meva, sabzavot, go'sht va baliq bozorlari
   bor — o'zingiz xitoy taomi tayyorlashingiz
   uchun kerak bo'lgan hamma narsa sotiladi.

   Nyu-York Chinatown'i Xitoy Yangi yili
   nishonlanganda haqiqatan jonlanadi.
   Ko'chalar turli millat odamlari bilan
   to'lib ketadi: ular ajoyib ajdaho va sher
   raqslarini tomosha qilishadi, hayratlanarli
   liboslarga qoyil qolishadi. An'anaga ko'ra,
   xitoylik do'kondorlar sher raqqoslariga pul
   berishlari kerak — shunda do'konlari yaxshi
   yil o'tkazadi. Qancha ko'p pul bersalar,
   shuncha ko'p omad keladi.'


⚠⚠ 'THE MORE ..., THE MORE ...':

  'THE MORE money they pay, THE MORE luck
   they will have.'
     = Qancha ko'p pul bersalar, shuncha
       ko'p omad keladi.

  ⚠ Bu — juda muhim qolip:
     'THE + qiyosiy daraja, THE + qiyosiy
      daraja'

  Boshqa misollar:
     'The bigger, the better.'
        = Qancha katta bo'lsa, shuncha
          yaxshi.
     'The more you study, the more you
      learn.'
     'The sooner, the better.'

  ⚠ Har ikkala qismda ham 'THE' KERAK!


⚠ 'AS IF' — GO'YO:

  'will feel AS IF they are in another
   world'
     = o'zini go'yo boshqa dunyoda his
       qiladi

  ⚠ 'as if' = go'yo, xuddi ... kabi.


⚠ 'SO THAT' — MAQSAD:

  'must pay the lion dancers SO THAT
   their shop has a good year'
     = ... shunda do'konlari yaxshi yil
       o'tkazadi

  ⚠ 'so that' = ... uchun, shunda
  (MAQSAD bildiradi).


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (2c mashqi uchun):

  based
     = joylashgan
     ⚠ 'a base' (asos, baza) dan

  oriental
     = sharqona
     ⚠ ESKI ATAMA — pastdagi izohga qarang

  winding
     = egri-bugri, buralgan
     ⚠ 'to wind' [waynd] = burmoq
     ⚠ 'wind' [wind] = shamol — BOShQA so'z!

  comes to life
     = jonlanadi
     ⚠ so'zma-so'z: 'hayotga keladi'

  crowded
     = odamga to'la, gavjum
     ⚠ 'a crowd' (olomon) dan

  incredible
     = hayratlanarli, aql bovar qilmas
     ⚠ 'in-' (inkor) + 'credible'
       (ishonarli)


⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'ORIENTAL':

  Matnda 'oriental dishes' va 'oriental
  carvings' deyilgan.

  ⚠ 'oriental' — ESKI atama.

  Hozirgi ingliz tilida:
     ODAMLAR haqida — 'Asian' yoki
        'East Asian'
        ('an oriental person' hozir
         XUNUK eshitiladi)
     BUYUMLAR haqida — 'Asian',
        'Chinese', 'Japanese'

  ⚠ Kitob yozilgan davrda bu so'z keng
  ishlatilar edi.

  ⚠ 156-betdagi 'Indian totem poles' bilan
  bir xil holat.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a community  = jamoa
  based        = joylashgan
  a visitor    = mehmon, tashrif buyuruvchi
  winding      = egri-bugri
  to decorate  = bezamoq
  crowded      = gavjum
  a crowd      = olomon
  to admire    = qoyil qolmoq
  a costume    = libos
  a shopkeeper = do'kondor
  luck         = omad
  incredible   = hayratlanarli
  amazing      = ajoyib
  to come to life = jonlanmoq
  as if        = go'yo
  so that      = ... uchun, shunda

points.en: Did you know that there are more Chinese people living in the United States than in any other country outside of Asia?
points.uz: Osiyodan tashqarida boshqa hech qaysi mamlakatda AQShdagichalik ko'p xitoylik yashamasligini bilarmidingiz?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Did you know that...?' — qiziqarli faktni
aytish qolipi (158-betda ham bor edi).

⚠ 'MORE ... THAN in ANY OTHER country' =
boshqa hech qaysi mamlakatdan ko'p.

⚠ 'the United States' — 'the' bilan!
Ko'plik nomli mamlakatlar 'the' oladi.

⚠ Bu gap 2a mashqining 5-bandiga javob: NY.

⚠ 'largest' — 2d mashqidagi ta'kidlangan
so'z (sinonimi: 'biggest').

⚠ 'is based' — majhul nisbat.
⚠ 'very own' = aynan o'z ('very' bu yerda
kuchaytiruvchi).

points.en: Any visitor to Manhattan's east side will feel as if they are in another world.
points.uz: Manxettenning sharqiy qismiga kelgan har qanday mehmon o'zini go'yo boshqa dunyoda his qiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu gap 2a mashqining 1-bandiga javob: NY.

⚠ 'AS IF' = go'yo, xuddi ... kabi.

⚠ 'any visitor ... THEY' — 'they' bu yerda
BIRLIK ma'nosida (erkak yoki ayol ekani
noma'lum bo'lganda ishlatiladi).

points.uz: Bu — yuzlab xitoy restoranlari bo'lgan ulkan hudud; u yerda mazali sharq taomlarini tatib ko'rish mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'huge' va 'delicious' — 2d mashqidagi
ta'kidlangan so'zlar.

⚠ 'HUNDREDS OF' — aniq raqamsiz KO'PLIK:
  'hundreds of restaurants'  ✓
  'two hundred restaurants'  ✓ (raqam bilan
  ko'plik YO'Q)

⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH: 'oriental' — ESKI atama.
Hozir 'Asian' yoki 'Chinese' deyiladi.

points.en: Visitors enjoy walking along the winding streets full of colourful shops.
points.uz: Mehmonlar rang-barang do'konlarga to'la egri-bugri ko'chalarda sayr qilishni yoqtiradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to enjoy' dan keyin '-ING':
  'enjoy WALKING'  ✓
  'enjoy to walk'  ✗

⚠⚠ 'WINDING' [WAYN-ding] = egri-bugri.
'to wind' [waynd] = burmoq.
⚠ 'wind' [wind] = SHAMOL — bir xil yoziladi,
BOSHQACHA o'qiladi!

⚠ 'full OF' — 'of' bilan.

points.en: New York City's Chinatown really comes to life during the Chinese New Year celebrations.
points.uz: Nyu-York Chinatown'i Xitoy Yangi yili nishonlanganda haqiqatan jonlanadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to COME TO LIFE' = jonlanmoq
(so'zma-so'z: 'hayotga kelmoq').

⚠ 'DURING' + OT ('while' + GAP):
  'during the celebrations'  ✓
  'during it is celebrated'  ✗

⚠ Xitoy Yangi yili oy taqvimi bo'yicha
yanvar-fevral oralig'ida nishonlanadi —
sanasi har yili o'zgaradi.

points.uz: Ko'chalar turli millat odamlari bilan to'lib ketadi — ular ajoyib ajdaho va sher raqslarini tomosha qilishadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'crowded WITH' — 'with' bilan.
'a crowd' = olomon.

⚠ 'amazing' — 2d mashqidagi ta'kidlangan
so'z (sinonimi: 'wonderful', 'incredible').

⚠ 'people of all nationalities' = turli
millat odamlari.

points.en: Traditionally, Chinese shopkeepers must pay the lion dancers so that their shop has a good year.

points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu gap 2a mashqining 2-bandiga javob: NY.

⚠ 'SO THAT' = ... uchun, shunda (MAQSAD).

⚠ 'a shopkeeper' = 'shop' + 'keeper'
(do'kon + saqlovchi) = do'kondor.

⚠ 'must' bu yerda an'anaviy majburiyat.

points.en: The more money they pay, the more luck they will have.
points.uz: Qancha ko'p pul bersalar, shuncha ko'p omad keladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ JUDA MUHIM QOLIP:
'THE + qiyosiy daraja, THE + qiyosiy daraja'

  'The bigger, the better.'
  'The more you study, the more you learn.'
  'The sooner, the better.'

⚠ Har ikkala qismda ham 'THE' KERAK!

⚠ 'luck' SANALMAYDI ('a luck' ✗).

exercises.instructionEn: 2  a) Read the texts and mark the statements NY (New York) or L (London). Then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  a) Matnlarni o'qing va gaplarni NY (Nyu-York) yoki L (London) deb belgilang. So'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠⚠ IKKI MATNNI TAQQOSLASh MAShQI.

  Har gap qaysi shaharga tegishli ekanini
  aniqlash kerak.

  ⚠ Nyu-York matni — 160-betda
  ⚠ London matni — 161-betda

  Demak IKKALA betni ham o'qish kerak!


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  NY  — Manxettenning sharqiy qismi
  2  NY  — do'kondorlar pul beradi
  3  L   — mashina kirishi taqiqlangan
  4  L   — petarda ovozi
  5  NY  — eng katta xitoy jamoasi

  ⚠ Ya'ni: uchtasi Nyu-York, ikkitasi
  London.


⚠⚠ IKKI ShAHARDA HAM BOR NARSALAR:

  Diqqat: ba'zi narsalar IKKALA matnda
  ham uchraydi — ular mashqda savol
  bo'lib kelmagan:

     • sher raqsi (lion dance)
     • xitoy restoranlari
     • Yangi yil nishonlash
     • rang-barang do'konlar

  ⚠ Mashqdagi 5 ta gap esa FAQAT bitta
  shaharga tegishli belgilardan tanlangan.


⚠ IKKI ChINATOWN — FARQLARI:

  NYU-YORK:
     • Manxettenning sharqiy qismida
     • Amerikaning eng katta xitoy jamoasi
     • do'kondorlar sher raqqoslariga pul
       beradi
     • meva, sabzavot, go'sht, baliq
       bozorlari

  LONDON:
     • Gerrard Street atrofida, shahar
       markazida
     • yashil-qizil Xitoy darvozasi
     • MAShINA KIRISh TAQIQLANGAN
     • Uzoq Sharqning boshqa
       mamlakatlaridan ham (Tailand,
       Indoneziya, Yaponiya, Gonkong)
     • bolalarga qizil pakatlarda pul
       beriladi


⚠ 'ARE ALLOWED' — MAJHUL NISBAT:

  'No cars ARE ALLOWED.'
     = Mashinalarga ruxsat berilmaydi.

  ⚠ 'to allow' = ruxsat bermoq.
  ⚠ 'NO cars' = birorta ham mashina yo'q.

items.textEn: 1  Chinatown is on the east side of Manhattan.
items.whyUz:
⚠ NYU-YORK (NY).

Matnda: 'Any visitor to MANHATTAN'S EAST
SIDE will feel as if they are in another
world.'

⚠ 'Manhattan' — Nyu-Yorkning markaziy
oroli. London matnida bunday joy nomi yo'q
(u yerda 'Gerrard Street').

items.textEn: 2  Shopkeepers give the lion dancers money.
items.whyUz:
⚠ NYU-YORK (NY).

Matnda: 'Chinese SHOPKEEPERS must PAY THE
LION DANCERS so that their shop has a good
year.'

⚠⚠ TUZOQ: sher raqsi IKKALA matnda ham bor!
Lekin DO'KONDORLAR PUL BERISHI faqat
Nyu-York matnida aytilgan.

⚠ London matnida esa BOLALARGA pul beriladi
— bu boshqa an'ana.

⚠ LONDON (L).

161-betdagi matnda: 'There is also a
pavilion and NO CARS ARE ALLOWED in the
area.'

⚠ Nyu-York matnida mashinalar haqida gap
YO'Q.

⚠ 'are allowed' — majhul nisbat
('to allow' = ruxsat bermoq).

items.textEn: 4  At New Year you can hear the sound of firecrackers.
items.uz: Yangi yilda petarda ovozini eshitish mumkin.
items.whyUz:
⚠ LONDON (L).

161-betdagi matnda: 'the SOUND of noisy
FIRECRACKERS fills the air'.

⚠ Nyu-York matnida Yangi yil bor, lekin
PETARDA haqida gap YO'Q — u yerda raqs va
liboslar tilga olingan.

⚠ 'fills the air' = havoni to'ldiradi.

items.textEn: 5  It has the largest Chinese community outside of Asia.
items.uz: Unda Osiyodan tashqaridagi eng katta xitoy jamoasi bor.
items.whyUz:
⚠ NYU-YORK (NY).

Matnning boshida: 'more Chinese people
living in the United States than in any
other country OUTSIDE OF ASIA' va
'AMERICA'S LARGEST Chinese community is
based in New York City's very own
Chinatown'.

⚠ 'a community' = jamoa.
⚠ 'largest' — 2d mashqidagi so'z
(sinonimi 'biggest').

exercises.instructionEn: 2  d) Suggest synonyms for the highlighted words.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'A SYNONYM' = SINONIM,
ma'nodosh so'z.

  ⚠ 156-betdagi mashqda ZID ma'noli
  so'zlar ('opposites') kerak edi.
  Bu yerda esa MA'NODOSh so'zlar.


TA'KIDLANGAN (sariq) SO'ZLAR:

  160-betda:  largest, huge, delicious,
              amazing
  161-betda:  cheap, feature

  ⚠ Jami OLTITA so'z, ikki betga tarqalgan.


SINONIMLAR:

  largest    →  biggest
  huge       →  enormous, very big
  delicious  →  tasty
  amazing    →  wonderful, incredible
  cheap      →  inexpensive, low-priced
  feature    →  part, attraction


⚠ QIZIQ NARSA:

  'amazing' ning sinonimi 'INCREDIBLE'
  AYNI MATNDA bor:

     'watching the AMAZING dragon and lion
      dances and admiring the INCREDIBLE
      costumes'

  ⚠ Muallif takrorlanmaslik uchun ikki
  xil so'z ishlatgan — bu yaxshi yozuv
  belgisi.


⚠ 'CHEAP' — EHTIYOT BO'LING:

     'cheap' = arzon

  ⚠ Lekin odam haqida aytilsa SALBIY:
     'a cheap person' = xasis

  ⚠ Xushmuomala variantlar:
     'inexpensive' = qimmat emas
     'affordable' = ko'tara oladigan
     'good value' = narxiga arziydi


⚠ 'FEATURE' — KO'P MA'NOLI:

     'a feature' = asosiy qism, xususiyat
        'the main feature' = asosiy qismi
     'features' = yuz tuzilishi
     'a feature film' = badiiy film


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a synonym    = sinonim
  an opposite  = zid ma'noli so'z
  enormous     = juda katta
  tasty        = mazali
  inexpensive  = qimmat emas
  a feature    = asosiy qism, xususiyat

pairs.whyUz:
Matnda: 'America's LARGEST Chinese
community'.

⚠ 'large' va 'big' — ma'nodosh, lekin
'large' rasmiyroq.

⚠ Orttirma darajada ikkalasi ham
tartibsiz emas: largEST, bigGEST
('g' ikkilanadi).

Matnda: 'It's a HUGE area'.

⚠ Kuch darajasi:
  big → large → huge → enormous

⚠ 'huge' 156-betda ham ta'kidlangan so'z
edi (u yerda zid ma'nosi 'small' kerak edi).

Matnda: 'DELICIOUS oriental dishes'.

⚠ 'delicious' — kuchliroq, 'tasty' —
oddiyroq.

⚠ 140-betdagi restoran taqrizida ham
'delicious' so'zi bor edi.

Matnda: 'the AMAZING dragon and lion
dances'.

⚠⚠ QIZIQ: 'amazing' ning yana bir sinonimi
— 'INCREDIBLE' — AYNI GAPDA bor:
'admiring the INCREDIBLE costumes'.

Muallif takrorlanmaslik uchun ikki xil so'z
ishlatgan.

161-betdagi matnda: 'everything from CHEAP
souvenirs to antique Chinese vases'.

⚠ EHTIYOT: 'cheap' odam haqida aytilsa
SALBIY ma'no beradi ('xasis').

⚠ Xushmuomala variantlar: 'inexpensive',
'affordable', 'good value'.

161-betdagi matnda: 'the lion dance is the
main FEATURE of the celebration'.

⚠ 'a feature' = asosiy qism, xususiyat.
Bu yerda 'the main part' yoki 'the main
attraction' deb ham aytish mumkin.

⚠ 'features' ko'plikda — yuz tuzilishi;
'a feature film' — badiiy film.

exercises.instructionEn: Speaking:  • What are the main nationalities of the people living in your country?  • What other nationalities live in your country? How do they live?  • How do you celebrate New Year?
exercises.instructionUz: Gapirish:  • Mamlakatingizda yashovchi odamlarning asosiy millatlari qaysilar?  • Yana qanday millatlar yashaydi? Ular qanday yashashadi?  • Yangi yilni qanday nishonlaysiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ UChTA MUHOKAMA SAVOLI.


BIRINChI va IKKINChI SAVOL —
MILLATLAR HAQIDA:

  NAMUNA JAVOB (O'zbekiston haqida):

     'The main nationality in Uzbekistan is
      Uzbek. Most people in my country are
      Uzbek and they speak Uzbek.

      But many other nationalities live
      here too. There are Russians, Tajiks,
      Kazakhs, Karakalpaks, Koreans, Tatars
      and others.

      They live together in the same
      cities and villages. Many of them
      speak two or three languages. They
      celebrate their own holidays, but
      they also celebrate Uzbek holidays
      like Navruz.

      Tashkent is a very mixed city -
      just like New York or London.'

  ⚠ Oxirgi gap savolni MATN bilan bog'laydi
  — bu javobni kuchli qiladi.


UChINChI SAVOL — YANGI YIL:

  NAMUNA JAVOB:

     'In Uzbekistan we celebrate New Year
      on the 31st of December. We decorate
      a New Year tree at home.

      The family sits together at a big
      table with a lot of food. At midnight
      we watch fireworks and say "Happy New
      Year!"

      Children get presents from Qorbobo -
      he is like Father Christmas.

      We also have another new year called
      NAVRUZ on the 21st of March. It is
      the first day of spring. People cook
      sumalak - a sweet dish made from
      wheat. It takes all night to cook it.'

  ⚠ NAVRUZ — juda yaxshi javob, chunki:
     • u ham YANGI YIL
     • u ham OY/QUYOSh taqvimiga bog'liq
       (xuddi Xitoy Yangi yili kabi!)
     • uning ham o'z maxsus taomi bor


⚠⚠ MILLAT NOMLARI — BOSh HARF BILAN!

     Uzbek, Russian, Tajik, Kazakh,
     Korean, Chinese, English

  ⚠ Ingliz tilida millat, til va mamlakat
  nomlari HAR DOIM BOSh HARF bilan
  yoziladi — gap o'rtasida ham!

  ⚠ O'zbek tilida esa kichik harf bilan:
  'o'zbek', 'rus', 'xitoy'.


⚠ 'NATIONALITY' va 'NATION':

     'a nation' = millat, xalq; davlat
     'a nationality' = millat, fuqarolik

  ⚠ 'What nationality are you?'
     = Siz qaysi millatdansiz?
  ⚠ Javob: 'I am Uzbek.' (artiklsiz)


⚠ 'TO CELEBRATE' + TO'G'RIDAN:

     'celebrate New Year'  ✓
     'celebrate ON New Year' ✗

  ⚠ Lekin SANA bilan 'ON':
     'on the 31st of December'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a nationality = millat
  to celebrate  = nishonlamoq
  a celebration = tantana
  a holiday     = bayram
  mixed         = aralash
  a tradition   = an'ana
  a present     = sovg'a
  midnight      = yarim tun

points.en: What are the main nationalities of the people living in your country?
points.uz: Mamlakatingizda yashovchi odamlarning asosiy millatlari qaysilar?
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ MILLAT NOMLARI BOSH HARF BILAN:
Uzbek, Russian, Tajik, Korean.

⚠ O'zbek tilida kichik harf, ingliz tilida
BOSH harf — bu farqni unutmang.

⚠ 'the people LIVING in your country' —
'-ing' shakli ('who live' o'rniga).

points.en: The main nationality in Uzbekistan is Uzbek, but many other nationalities live here too.
points.uz: O'zbekistonda asosiy millat — o'zbek, lekin bu yerda boshqa ko'p millatlar ham yashaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ NAMUNA JAVOB.

⚠ 'I am Uzbek.' — ARTIKLSIZ.
('I am an Uzbek' ham to'g'ri, lekin
artiklsiz shakl ko'proq ishlatiladi.)

⚠ 'too' gap OXIRIDA — 'ham'.

points.en: Tashkent is a very mixed city - just like New York or London.
points.uz: Toshkent — juda aralash shahar, xuddi Nyu-York yoki London kabi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu gap javobni MATN bilan bog'laydi —
shuning uchun kuchli javob.

⚠ 'just like' = xuddi ... kabi.

⚠ Muhokamada matndagi misolga qaytish —
yaxshi usul.

points.en: How do you celebrate New Year?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to celebrate' TO'G'RIDAN to'ldiruvchi
oladi:
  'celebrate New Year'     ✓
  'celebrate ON New Year'  ✗

⚠ Lekin SANA bilan 'ON':
'on the 31st of December'.

points.en: We also have another new year called Navruz on the 21st of March.
points.uz: Bizda yana bir yangi yil bor — 21-martdagi Navro'z.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ JUDA YAXSHI JAVOB. Nega?

Chunki Navro'z Xitoy Yangi yiliga
O'XSHAYDI:
  • ikkalasi ham YANGI YIL
  • ikkalasi ham taqvim (quyosh/oy) bilan
    bog'liq, sanasi qat'iy emas
  • ikkalasining ham o'z maxsus taomi bor

⚠ 'called' = deb ataladigan — milliy so'zni
tushuntirish qolipi.

points.en: People cook sumalak - a sweet dish made from wheat. It takes all night to cook it.
points.uz: Odamlar sumalak pishirishadi — bug'doydan tayyorlanadigan shirin taom. Uni pishirish butun tunni oladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'made FROM' = ... dan tayyorlangan
(material tanib bo'lmaydigan darajada
o'zgargan).

⚠ 'made OF' = ... dan yasalgan
(material ko'rinib turadi):
'a table made OF wood'.

⚠ 'It takes + VAQT + to + fe'l' —
154-betdagi qolip.
